summary: This 8-K filed by D. Boral ARC Acquisition I Corp. updates on its pending business combination with Exascale Labs. The registrant, a SPAC, entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger on January 11, 2026. The filing furnishes a press release about Exascale's CEO speaking at an industry forum, containing forward-looking statements about the deal's expected closing, post-combination entity (to be Exascale Labs Holdings Inc., ticker XLAB), and technologies. No new deal terms are provided. Filing is a standard SPAC progress update; the de-SPAC transaction remains pending. Risk-arb angle: monitor shareholder vote and regulatory and Nasdaq listing approvals.
